matchedProtocolModel.boundary: End-to-end network state-transition model calibrated by separately executed cryptographic components; not a field deployment or per-request cryptographic replay.

matchedRouting.finding: Risk-priority and equal-copy Binary Spray-and-Wait tie on both reported endpoints in every paired cell; this grid does not establish H4.
matchedRouting.boundary: Routing factorial only; fixed 8 sites/250 bundles/zero loss. No DPDRM, CSAR, cryptographic online baseline or original holdout.

coconutOnline.boundary: unit-token Coconut-Online adaptation; true Coconut; single online ledger; no matched network campaign

snappy.boundary: Not the authors' original contract and not an offline-network comparator. The literal equal-value Algorithm 4 boundary remains unresolved.

SnappyAdapted: resolve literal Algorithm 4 equal-value conflict behavior
DPDRM: authors' The ONE scenario and code
complete group-delivery predictability update and aging defaults
CSAR: authors' The ONE scenario and code
complete selector weights and calibration procedure
GiniPenalized: fixed source objective and penalty tuning rule

decision: CoconutOnline and FirstSeenDTN may be reported as matched protocol-model comparators. Snappy may be reported only as a connected component reconstruction. DPDRM and CSAR remain related-work comparators because their available primary specifications do not support faithful execution.
